evidence.FACTS: States that guides are informational and that prices, availability and conditions are confirmed by Thuê xe máy Nguyễn Hà (Long Biên) before booking; points to the owner indicative price table on /prix-location/ without quoting amounts; no deposit/passport/insurance/fleet claims; model presence ≠ availability; legal rules depend on nationality/licence/vehicle; illustrations are not shop photos. '~500 guides' matches the 500-article matrix.
evidence.INTENT: Primary intent: blog moto vietnam / guide index for French speakers. Owner URL /blog/. Distinct from theme pages (each covers one topic exhaustively) and /faq/ (short answers): it explains the nine themes, routes questions to the right theme and features 5–6 strong guides per theme without listing all 500.
evidence.CONTENT: Entire article replaced (old copy discussed silos, cannibalisation, 'futurs articles', référencement). Sections: Comment utiliser ce blog; Par où commencer (question→theme table, 9 rows); 9 theme sections (Location Hanoi, Prix et budget, Types de motos, Honda, Yamaha, Permis et sécurité, Hanoi, Nord, Centre et Sud) each with a descriptive paragraph + 5–6 featured guides (guide-list, 50 total, all existing in silo-children.json); Comment lire nos guides (reader checklist); FAQ x6; Explorer les thèmes (context links).
